title: Light Demands His Own Arrest Part 3

series.summary: Light turns himself into L and demands solitary confinement to execute a daring counter-gamble after Rem threatens his life.

cuts.voiceover_text: Facing execution from a Shinigami, Light Yagami makes an unthinkable move. Rem promises to kill him if Misa dies in confinement. Trapped between L's investigation and a Death God's blade, Light refuses to panic. Instead, he turns to Ryuk with a chilling farewell. Light walks straight into police custody and demands to be locked in a cell. L locks the heavy doors shut. Light is trapped. Or is this the trap?
